name: Roasted Butternut Squash Puree (Peeled & Blended)
whyItWorks: Roasted butternut squash yields sweet, velvety flesh loaded with vitamin A. Blending it into a silky soup or puree breaks down any remaining fiber strands, making it soothing and completely low-residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel tough tan rind and scoop out all seeds before roasting. Roast chunks until fork-tender and puree in a blender with warm broth and a pinch of salt.
watchOuts: Ensure all fibrous stringy seed pith and seeds are completely removed prior to blending.
